authority: Registered command-staff roles. Staff authority is scoped to the command group where the person is assigned. It never creates troop ownership, hidden knowledge, succession, combat power, or instantaneous communication.

strategist.knowledge_rule: May act only on information lawfully available or delivered to that strategist/command staff.
strategist.communication_rule: Orders still use the normal messenger/signaling/communication path and latency; recursive authority never teleports instructions or formations.
strategist.decision_rule: May formulate, coordinate, and transmit plans/orders within the assigned command subtree. The commander remains the command group's senior decision authority unless a separate lawful delegation or succession state says otherwise.

chief_administrator.knowledge_rule: May use only information lawfully available or delivered to this staff appointment.
chief_administrator.communication_rule: Staff work uses normal command communication paths and latency.
chief_administrator.decision_rule: Administrative coordination role with no inherent operational order authority.

chief_of_staff.knowledge_rule: May use only information lawfully available or delivered to this staff appointment.
chief_of_staff.communication_rule: Staff work uses normal command communication paths and latency.
chief_of_staff.decision_rule: Staff coordination role with no inherent operational order authority unless separately delegated.

operations_officer.communication_rule: Staff work uses normal command communication paths and latency.
operations_officer.decision_rule: Operational staff role that supports planning/execution but has no inherent recursive order authority.

training_and_operations_officer.decision_rule: Combined training/operations staff role without inherent recursive order authority.
